prompt.alinti: Claude just killed marketing agencies. You can now build a $1 million marketing team directly inside Claude. Let me show you how in 60 seconds.
First, search 'Marketing Skills Claude' and click the first link.
Scroll down and you'll find 29 completely free Claude marketing skills for things like ad creatives, copywriting, and email sequences.
Click the skill you want, open the SkillMD file, then download the raw file.
Now, go to Claude, Customize, plus Upload Skill, and drag the file in.
Now, when you ask Claude to create a comprehensive content strategy for your business,
it'll actually pull from that skill and give you crazy outputs, like an entire content strategy playbook and full, done-for-you ad creatives ready to publish.
Want the full step-by-step guide? Follow me in Comment 'Marketing' and I'll send it over.

yontem.ne: Marketing faaliyetleri için AI destekli özelleştirilebilir beceriler sunan bir platform.

akis.ne: Arama yap: 'Marketing Skills Claude' yazıp ilk bağlantıya tıklama.
akis.alinti: First, search 'Marketing Skills Claude' and click the first link.

akis.ne: Sayfayı aşağı kaydır: 29 adet ücretsiz Claude marketing becerisi listeleniyor.
akis.alinti: Scroll down and you'll find 29 completely free Claude marketing skills for things like ad creatives, copywriting, and email sequences.

akis.ne: İstediğiniz beceriye tıklama, ardından SkillMD dosyasını açma ve raw dosyayı indirme.
akis.alinti: Click the skill you want, open the SkillMD file, then download the raw file.

akis.ne: Claude'a girdiğinizde Customize sekmesinden '+' simgesine tıklayarak Upload Skill seçeneğini kullanarak dosyayı sürükleyip bırakma.
akis.alinti: Now, go to Claude, Customize, plus Upload Skill, and drag the file in.

akis.ne: Claude'a bir içerik stratejisi oluşturma isteğinde bulunulduğunda, yüklenen beceri kullanılarak otomatize edilmiş çıktılar (strateji playbook ve hazır reklamlar) sağlanıyor.
akis.alinti: Now, when you ask Claude to create a comprehensive content strategy for your business, it'll actually pull from that skill and give you crazy outputs, like an entire content strategy playbook and full, done-for-you ad creatives ready to publish.

yazi: Marketing Skills Claude (github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills), SkillMD dosyaları, Claude Customize sekmesi, Upload Skill, 29 adet ücretsiz beceri, ad creatives, copywriting, email sequences, raw dosya indirme, 60 saniyelik süreç.
